Two MAJ findings remain: the YAML lint check's pyyaml-absent handler exits code 1 under set -euo pipefail (turns a skip into a hard abort), and the --pr mode test lacks onboarded-operator-bump and blocked-on-adopter-conflict coverage (the blocked-on-adopter-conflict negative log-modification assertion traverses gh pr diff --name-only, a code path never exercised by run_pr_case).
